newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki still on a roll as Nokia, Raisio bounce.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki still on a roll as Nokia, Raisio bounce.

text.p: Shares conquered new record ground on Wednesday with heavy and bullish trade in Raisio and Nokia, and Merita joining a Europe-wide rally, brokers said.
The FOX index added 2.2 percent or 26.03 points to 1,209.66, about seven points of which came from Raisio's climb. Nokia boosted the index by a total of around nine points.

"Right now, Raisio reminds me of four years ago when I was looking at Nokia," said one broker. "It was becoming a totally different company." Raisio was being similarly revalued as a new product exposing it to U.S. consumer markets will transform its earnings profile, he added.

Raisio closed up a massive 87.00 markka or 18.20 percent at 565.00 after hitting a 580.00 markka record earlier. It has now added over 50 percent in just two days on a deal with U.S. group Johnson & Johnson to market its cholesterol-cutting agent Benecol in North American markets.

As Raisio took a breather in the afternoon -- with many operators waiting for more information about the North American launch of Benecol and how Raisio would manage the expected growth -- bulls turned to Nokia.
"This is an ideal scenario for equities," one broker said, pointing to low interest rates and strong economic growth.
Nokia rose on lively foreign demand after a big Australian order and a note from Salomon Brothers which said it preferred Nokia to Ericsson, which it initiated with a buy recommendation.
It closed up 16.80 markka or almost four percent at 441.00, it highest close ever, after hitting a 446.00 markka record in lively trade of almost 300 million markka.
Banking group Merita touched an all-time high of 22.10 markka before retreating, but still closed up 0.50 or over two percent at 21.50 markka.
Sentiment was strong, but some brokers said a correction could follow such massive gains.
